title: RAG Tools and Loaders
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of data loaders for various content types, including files, web pages, databases, and online platforms. It also includes utilities for text chunking and internal helpers for RAG tool configuration and input validation.

nodes.label: Base Loader Interface
nodes.title: Abstract Base Loader
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for all data loaders, including a method to load content and generate unique document IDs.

nodes.label: Text Chunker
nodes.title: Text Splitting Utility
nodes.description: Splits large text documents into smaller, manageable chunks based on size, overlap, and separators, using RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter.

nodes.label: CSV Data Loader
nodes.title: CSV File/URL Loader
nodes.description: Loads and parses content from CSV files or URLs, extracting structured data into a readable text format.

nodes.label: Directory File Loader
nodes.title: Recursive Directory Processor
nodes.description: Recursively loads and processes multiple files from a local directory, supporting filtering by extension and file limits.

nodes.label: Documentation Site Loader
nodes.title: Web Documentation Scraper
nodes.description: Extracts main content, titles, and navigation links from documentation websites, handling HTML parsing and truncation.

nodes.label: DOCX File Loader
nodes.title: Word Document Extractor
nodes.description: Loads and extracts text content from Microsoft Word (.docx) files, supporting both local files and URLs.

nodes.label: GitHub Repository Loader
nodes.title: GitHub Content Extractor
nodes.description: Loads various content types (repo info, README, file structure, PRs, issues) from a specified GitHub repository.

nodes.label: JSON Data Loader
nodes.title: JSON File/URL Parser
nodes.description: Loads and parses JSON content from files or URLs, converting structured JSON data into a flattened text representation.

nodes.label: MDX Content Loader
nodes.title: MDX File/URL Parser
nodes.description: Loads and cleans MDX (Markdown with JSX) content from files or URLs, removing JSX tags and import/export statements.

nodes.label: MySQL Database Loader
nodes.title: MySQL Query Executor
nodes.description: Connects to a MySQL database using a provided URI and executes SQL queries to fetch and format data into text.

nodes.label: PDF Document Loader
nodes.title: PDF Text Extractor
nodes.description: Loads PDF files from local paths or URLs, extracting text content page by page using PyMuPDF.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database Loader
nodes.title: PostgreSQL Query Executor
nodes.description: Connects to a PostgreSQL database using a provided URI and executes SQL queries to fetch and format data into text.

nodes.label: Local Text File Loader
nodes.title: Plain Text File Reader
nodes.description: Loads raw text content directly from a specified local file path.

nodes.label: Raw Text Loader
nodes.title: Direct Text Content Loader
nodes.description: A simple loader that directly uses a provided text string as its content, without external fetching or parsing.

nodes.label: Web Page Scraper
nodes.title: HTML Web Page Extractor
nodes.description: Fetches and scrapes content from a given URL, extracting visible text and metadata from HTML pages.

nodes.label: XML Data Loader
nodes.title: XML File/URL Parser
nodes.description: Loads and parses XML content from files or URLs, extracting all text nodes into a single string.

nodes.label: YouTube Channel Loader
nodes.title: YouTube Channel Content Extractor
nodes.description: Loads metadata and summaries/transcripts for multiple videos from a specified YouTube channel URL.

nodes.label: YouTube Video Loader
nodes.title: YouTube Video Transcript Extractor
nodes.description: Extracts the full transcript and metadata from a single YouTube video URL.

nodes.label: RAG Adapter Configuration
nodes.title: Ensures RAG Adapter Setup
nodes.description: Internal helper to ensure a RAG adapter (e.g., CrewAIRagAdapter) is properly initialized and configured for a RAG tool.

nodes.label: URL Input Validator
nodes.title: Validates URLs for RAG Tools
nodes.description: Internal utility to validate and sanitize URL inputs, preventing unsafe or malformed URLs from being processed by RAG tools.

nodes.label: File Path Input Validator
nodes.title: Validates File Paths for RAG Tools
nodes.description: Internal utility to validate and sanitize file path inputs, ensuring they are safe and exist for RAG tools.

nodes.label: Source Content Input
nodes.title: Input Data Source
nodes.description: Represents the input source for data loaders, encapsulating file paths, URLs, or raw content strings.

nodes.label: Loader Output Result
nodes.title: Processed Data Output
nodes.description: Encapsulates the result of a data loading operation, including extracted content, source reference, metadata, and a document ID.

nodes.label: Recursive Text Splitter
nodes.title: LangChain Text Splitter
nodes.description: A text splitting utility from LangChain that recursively splits text by characters, aiming to keep paragraphs and sentences together.

nodes.label: HTTP Request Library
nodes.title: Python Requests Library
nodes.description: A popular Python library for making HTTP requests, used by loaders to fetch content from URLs.

nodes.label: HTML Parser
nodes.title: Beautiful Soup Library
nodes.description: A Python library for parsing HTML and XML documents, used to extract structured data from web pages.

nodes.label: DOCX Library
nodes.title: Python-Docx Library
nodes.description: A Python library for creating and modifying Microsoft Word (.docx) files, used here for reading content.

nodes.label: GitHub API Client
nodes.title: PyGithub Library
nodes.description: A Python library to access the GitHub API, used for fetching repository information and file contents.

nodes.label: PDF Processing Library
nodes.title: PyMuPDF Library
nodes.description: A high-performance Python library for PDF processing, used for extracting text from PDF documents.

nodes.label: YouTube Downloader
nodes.title: Pytube Library
nodes.description: A Python library for downloading YouTube videos and extracting video information, used for channel and video metadata.

nodes.label: YouTube Transcript API
nodes.title: YouTube Transcript API Library
nodes.description: A Python library to fetch YouTube video transcripts, including auto-generated ones.

nodes.label: SQL Database Connectors
nodes.title: Database Connection Libraries
nodes.description: Generic representation for Python libraries used to connect and query SQL databases like MySQL and PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: CrewAI RAG Adapter
nodes.title: CrewAI RAG Integration
nodes.description: An adapter for integrating RAG functionalities within CrewAI, handling collection management and retrieval.

groups.label: Core RAG Utilities
groups.title: Core RAG Utilities
groups.description: Fundamental components for RAG operations, including the base loader interface and text chunking.

groups.label: File-based Content Loaders
groups.title: File-based Content Loaders
groups.description: Loaders designed to extract content from various local file formats like CSV, DOCX, JSON, MDX, PDF, plain text, and XML.

groups.label: Web-based Content Loaders
groups.title: Web-based Content Loaders
groups.description: Loaders for fetching and parsing content from online sources such as documentation sites, general web pages, GitHub repositories, and YouTube channels/videos.

groups.label: Database Content Loaders
groups.title: Database Content Loaders
groups.description: Loaders for connecting to and extracting data from relational databases like MySQL and PostgreSQL using SQL queries.

groups.label: Generic Text Loader
groups.title: Generic Text Loader
groups.description: A simple loader for directly processing raw text strings as content.

groups.label: Directory Content Loader
groups.title: Directory Content Loader
groups.description: A specialized loader for recursively processing and aggregating content from multiple files within a local directory.

groups.label: RAG Tool Internal Helpers
groups.title: RAG Tool Internal Helpers
groups.description: Internal utilities supporting RAG tool functionality, including adapter configuration and input validation for URLs and file paths.
